text:
Elaine: Quick PSA — I found several 404s on the Optimize toolkit batching + caching page and a couple of standalone snippets that still call the old streaming API surface. Opening a small PR to rewrite the standalone examples for Python and Node and to fix broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :eyeglasses:
Raj: Nice catch. Do we know which pages are 404ing?
Elaine: The main offenders are:/optimize/batching/cache.md -> some relative links to /examples/snippets/ were removed during the examples move, and /optimize/quant/profiles.md has an internal anchor that changed.
Kevin: Which snippets use the old streaming API? Is it the `client.stream` call?
Elaine: Yep. Current snippet (old):

```python
# old example - SDK v1 style
with client.stream.responses(model="rwr/small") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```

New SDK v2 pattern we want in docs (py + node):

```python
# new example - SDK v2 (streams are async iterables or response chunks)
async for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="rwr/small"):
    print(chunk.delta)
```

and for Node:
```js
// new node example
for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwr/small' })) {
  console.log(chunk.delta)
}
```

Elaine: The PR updates: 1) replace old snippet blocks with the new SDK v2 streaming examples, 2) add non-streaming alternatives (sync/awaitable examples) for users who don't want streaming, 3) add redirects for two moved example pages, 4) fix the quant profile anchor.
Raj: Do we need an entry in migration guide? Might be good to add a one-paragraph note at top of the toolkit page that streaming examples moved and SDK calls changed.
Kevin: Also add a tiny CI smoke check that lints example link targets on merge? We keep getting link rot after the example reorg.
Tim: I can wire a quick docs CI job that runs a link-checker on changed files only. Point it at the GH Actions matrix for docs changes.
Elaine: Thanks — action list in the PR description. Specific requests: @Raj can you review wording for the migration blurb? @Kevin can you sanity-check the streaming examples for correctness? @Tim can you add the link-checker job?
Raj: Will review tomorrow AM.
Kevin: I'll test the snippets against the staging SDK tomorrow — flagging that the Node example in the repo needs `for await` wording + mention of Node 18+.
Tim: I'll draft the link-checker action and push to the PR branch — will ping when ready.
DocsBot: Automated note: PR 4821 created by Elaine and assigned to Raj, Kevin, Tim. CI: docs-build pending.
Elaine: Small follow-up — also added a fallback non-streaming example so users can copy-paste without async/for-await hassles. Example looks like:

```python
# sync-style (blocking) example using client.generate for simple cases
resp = client.generate(model='rwr/small', input='Summarize the product goals')
print(resp.output_text)
```

Elaine: If anyone sees other pages that reference `client.stream` or old anchors, drop them in this thread and I'll add fixes to the same PR. :thumbsup:
Raj: Noted — I'll grep the docs repo for `client.stream` and `responses.stream` and post results here.
Kevin: Found one more in examples/quickstarts/node/old-stream.md — adding to the PR list.
Elaine: Perfect. Goal: merge by EOD Friday if reviews + link-checker look good. Thanks all.
